svg.title: Festival face map
svg.text: The five festival zones and the eye area (dotted). Plan a layout here before you paint. Lesson 05.3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
1 brow-to-temple arc · 2 cheekbone line · 3 third eye (forehead center) · 4 hairline · 5 chin
Dotted ovals: the eye area. Only eye-safe products there (lesson 05.4).
